subject: note: Passive social media use (called PSMU in some of the literature) induces fatigue, loneliness, depression, a kind of seventeenth-century Pascalian ennui, and the sense that our lives are inadequate and pointless in comparison to the manufactured glamour, righteous moralized rage and simple falsehood that stares back at us continuously from our tiny screens in an uninterrupted, rising flood tide.
